ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio favoring low-intensity pixels; the fluke surface is approximately 95% black (low intensity) with roughly 5% high-intensity white pixel clusters corresponding to scarring and peripheral anomalies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a monolithic low-intensity black field. High-intensity white pixel clusters are mapped as discrete linear segments across the medial right lobe and as dense, irregular geometric blobs at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated acute angle of approximately 55 degrees, showing high-contrast definition against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across the central trailing edge; transitions to high-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks at the distal terminal tips, particularly on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature extending from the median notch toward the lateral tips, exhibiting an upward-sloping arc relative to the central horizontal axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized circular clusters of high-intensity white pixels concentrated at the terminal edges and outer tips of both lobes, consistent with localized surface encrustation sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-contrast white linear pixel paths (rake marks) distributed across the central and lateral regions of both lobes, most prominent on the right lobe's medial surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the entire visible surface; significant irregular tissue margins/topography on the right distal tip indicating potential past trauma or heavy colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-contrast white focal spotting localized on the lower-left proximal surface near the fluke-peduncle transition.
